title: ExtensionSignature
description:
META-INF/nova-signature.json inside a .novax bundle (FR-117, ADR-097 D2). A .novax is a zip of the extension folder (the plugin format plus .nova-plugin/extension.json) and this file. digest is the hex SHA-256 over the lines "<path>
<hex sha256 of the entry's bytes>
" of every other entry, sorted by byte order and joined with nothing; paths are relative, use /, and never hold a control character, .. or an empty segment. signature is Ed25519 by publisher over the UTF-8 bytes of "nova-extension-v1
" + digest. A signature that does not match the files makes the bundle invalid (never installed); a good signature by a key outside plugins.trustedPublishers, or no signature file, is Unverified. Mirrors signatureFileSchema in packages/core/src/sdk/bundle.ts.

publisher.description: The publisher's raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key, base64url without padding.

digest.description: Hex SHA-256 of the sorted file listing.

signature.description: The 64-byte Ed25519 signature, base64url without padding.
